links.outcome: LLM colonoscopy interval recommendation concordance with guideline-directed endoscopist panel
links.effect: GPT3.5 concordance 60.4% vs Bard 50.0% (P<0.001); kappa 0.324 for GPT3.5 and 0.219 for Bard; low accuracy excludes use as sole agent.
links.quote: Although the potential of freely available LLMs to offer uniformity is significant, the low accuracy, as noted, excludes their use as the sole agent in providing recommendations.

links.outcome: LLM concordance with panel by hospital setting (safety-net vs private)
links.effect: Safety-net: GPT3.5 60.5% vs Bard 45.7% (P<0.001); private: 60.3% vs 54.3% (P=0.13). Bard kappa 0.148 safety-net vs 0.282 private.
links.quote: In the safety-net hospital, GPT3.5 had a 60.5% concordance rate with the panel compared with Bard's 45.7% ( P < 0.001).

screen.reason: The study retrospectively evaluates the performance and accuracy of ChatGPT-3.5 and Bard on colonoscopy interval recommendations compared to an expert panel, without evaluating a specific implementation safeguard or deployment practice.
